resources.string: Keeps the Slivue edge service running in the background.
Set up permissions for Slivue first.
Hello! This is a Slivue test notification.

In One Hand Operation +, assign Home screen shortcuts → Slivue: Open notification panel to a gesture. Enable ‘Pause video before opening the panel’ to reduce PiP transitions. If the shortcut is missing, open Slivue once and reopen the list.
The notification panel is available at the edge of your screen.
